method: breaths by loudness (under -14 dB for 0.4 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 14 of 14 breaks heard

lines.latin: Ave maris stella, Dei Mater alma,
lines.english: Hail, O Star of the ocean, God's own Mother blest,

lines.latin: atque semper Virgo, felix cæli porta.
lines.english: ever sinless Virgin, gate of heavenly rest.
Taking that sweet Ave, which from Gabriel came,

lines.latin: Funda nos in pace, Mutans Hevæ nomen.
lines.english: peace confirm within us, changing Eve's name.

lines.latin: Solve vincla reis, Profer lumen cæcis
lines.english: Break the sinners' fetters, make our blindness day,

lines.latin: Mala nostra pelle, Bona cuncta posce.
lines.english: chase all evils from us, for all blessings pray.

lines.latin: Monstra te esse matrem: Sumat per te preces,
lines.english: Show thyself a Mother, may the Word divine

lines.latin: Qui pro nobis natus, Tulit esse tuus.
lines.english: born for us thine Infant hear our prayers through thine.
Virgin all excelling, mildest of the mild,

lines.latin: Nos culpis solútos, Mitis fac et castos.
lines.english: free from guilt preserve us meek and undefiled.

lines.latin: Vitam præsta puram, Iter para tutum:
lines.english: Keep our life all spotless, make our way secure
till we find in Jesus, joy for evermore.

lines.latin: Sit laus Deo Patri, Summo Christo decus,
lines.english: Praise to God the Father, honor to the Son,
in the Holy Spirit, be the glory one.
